class.name: MultiplayerViewport
class.brief_description: A [SubViewport] that runs its own multiplayer session.
class.description: Its children use [member api] as [member Node.multiplayer] and live in its own worlds, so two of them in one process never see or touch each other. Show one with a [StretchViewportContainer]. [codeblock] var seat := MultiplayerViewport.new() seat.add_child(preload("res://main.tscn").instantiate()) $SplitScreen/Left.add_child(seat) [/codeblock]

members.member: The [NetwMultiplayer] its children use. Replace it before the viewport enters the tree to use your own subclass.
